_about: Approved list for scripts/check-site-truth.mjs, which runs before every build. Every outside domain referenced in the code and every package in package.json dependencies must be listed here. 'disclosedAs' is the word that must appear on the Privacy Policy page (src/app/(site)/privacy/page.tsx) because that service receives visitor data; null means it receives none (a plain link, a schema URL, or a library that runs on our own server). Adding an entry is a decision about the privacy policy, not a formality: if the new thing receives visitor data, update the Privacy Policy and LEGAL_EFFECTIVE_DATE in the same change. See AGENTS.md, 'Keeping the site truthful'.

maps.google.com.purpose: Links only (Google Maps listing, Google Maps terms)

policies.google.com.purpose: Links only (Google terms and privacy policy)

*.googleusercontent.com.purpose: Reviewer profile photos loaded from Google

cdn.sanity.io.purpose: Blog and site images from Sanity

challenges.cloudflare.com.purpose: Cloudflare Turnstile on the contact form (script, iframe, server verify)

forbiddenPatterns.why: The Privacy Policy says the site does not use cookies to track visitors.
Storing data in visitors' browsers must be reviewed against the Privacy Policy's cookie section first.

Ad pixels, session replay, chat widgets and schedulers are the main source of California wiretap (CIPA) lawsuits and would make the Privacy Policy untrue. Garrett must approve, and the Privacy Policy must be updated, first.
